page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g5.8xlarge is a general-purpose virtual machine instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features an Intel Xeon 8163 processor with 32 dedicated physical cores running at 2.5 GHz on the x86_64 architecture. The instance is configured with 128.0 GB of system memory, providing a balanced allocation of 4.0 GB of RAM per core. It does not include local storage or dedicated GPU hardware. Network connectivity is supported by a baseline bandwidth of 10 Gbps.

Benchmark data indicates a clear performance tradeoff between single-core and multi-core execution. Single-core performance is relatively weak, with stress-ng single-core, Geekbench single-core, and bzip3 single-threaded decompression scoring in the bottom 25%, while single-threaded gzip compression falls into the bottom 10%. Conversely, multi-core benchmarks, including stress-ng multi-core, Geekbench multi-core, and multi-threaded bzip3 decompression, consistently achieve average performance in the middle 50% tier. Memory bandwidth tests for both small cached and large uncached blocks also fall within the average range.

The instance demonstrates average performance across standard operations such as PassMark database tests, Redis SET operations, and static web serving throughput. For machine learning tasks, the CPU-based LLM inference speeds for small and medium models remain in the average tier. Given the dedicated CPU allocation and balanced resource density, this instance offers stable multi-threaded execution for general-purpose workloads, such as web serving, database operations, and software compilation, though it is less suited for single-thread-bound tasks.
